'''Brian Donald Moorman''' (born February 5, 1976) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[Punter (gridiron football)|punter]] in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[Pittsburg State Gorillas football|Pittsburg State Gorillas]], and was signed by the [[Seattle Seahawks]] as an [[undrafted free agent]] after the [[1999 NFL draft]].

He played for the [[Buffalo Bills]] from 2001 to 2012, to which he returned after a one-year absence in 2013. He also played for the [[Dallas Cowboys]] in 2012, and was a member of the [[Pittsburgh Steelers]] during the offseason prior to 2013, but was waived during the preseason. Moorman is a two-time [[Pro Bowl]] selection and was voted to the [[Buffalo Bills#50th Anniversary Team|Buffalo Bills 50th Anniversary Team]] and the [[NFL 2000s All-Decade Team]].

He is the founder of the P.U.N.T. Foundation, which supports children in [[Western New York]] who face life-threatening illnesses.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.puntfoundation.org/about|title=About {{!}} Brian Moorman's PUNT Foundation|website=www.puntfoundation.org|access-date=May 25, 2016}}</ref>

'''Brian Keith Mitchell''' (born August 18, 1968) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[running back]] and [[return specialist]] in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] as a [[quarterback]] for the [[Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns football|Southwestern Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns]] and was selected by the [[Washington Redskins]] in the fifth round of the [[1990 NFL draft]].
Mitchell is considered one of the greatest return specialists in NFL history.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nix |first=JW |title=Why Brian Mitchell Is the Best Return Specialist in NFL History |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/189034-brian-mitchell-the-best-return-specialist-in-nfl-history |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160306025340/http://bleacherreport.com/articles/189034-brian-mitchell-the-best-return-specialist-in-nfl-history |archive-date=March 6, 2016 |access-date=November 4, 2015 |website=Bleacher Report}}</ref>

Mitchell also played for the [[Philadelphia Eagles]] and the [[New York Giants]]. He is currently second on the [[List of National Football League career all-purpose yards leaders|NFL's all-time all-purpose yardage]] with 23,330 yards, behind [[Jerry Rice]]. He is also first all-time for combined yardage for a non-wide receiver. His 13 special teams [[touchdown]]s are second in NFL history, behind [[Devin Hester]], and his nine punt return touchdowns are third behind [[Eric Metcalf]] with 10, and Hester with 14. Mitchell was ranked the second greatest specialist in NFL history by [[NFL Network]]'s [[NFL Top 10]] Return Aces.

As of February 2021, Mitchell began co-hosting the radio show "BMitch and Finlay" on [[WJFK-FM]] with JP Finlay of [[NBC Sports Washington]].
